rationale: The pipeline ported 'QOB Table IV.do' to R (reg->lm, ivregress 2sls->AER::ivreg) in port_table4.R and produced outputs/table4.json on the 1970 Census extract of men born 1920-1929 with N=247,199 (matching the claim exactly). The eight EDUC coefficients produced are col1 OLS=0.08015946 (t=225.7), col2 TSLS=0.07685568 (t=5.11), col3 OLS=0.08016756, col4 TSLS=0.13104244, col5 OLS=0.07011881, col6 TSLS=0.06685089, col7 OLS=0.07012416, col8 TSLS=0.10071515. Rounded to the paper's precision these are [0.0802, 0.0769, 0.0802, 0.1310, 0.0701, 0.0669, 0.0701, 0.1007], identical to the paper values [0.0802, 0.0769, 0.0802, 0.1310, 0.0701, 0.0669, 0.0701, 0.1007] — every cell is within <0.1% relative error (far inside the 5% match threshold). The col2 TSLS t-ratio of 5.11 matches the paper's reported t=5.1, and columns without quadratic age (2,6) give TSLS≈0.067-0.077 close to the OLS≈0.070-0.080, as the claim describes. Step 2 completed with exit_code 0 (replication_log.json). The only deviation from the claim text is the col1 OLS t-ratio (produced 225.7 vs paper's 200.5), a nuisance-statistic difference that does not affect the coefficient row being graded. Evidence: outputs/table4.json.
